integrity: The infinite proof uses a proved prior morphic representation and an exhaustive six-word finite factor cover with an explicit central-palindrome argument. Finite prefix experiments corroborate but do not establish the infinite conclusion. Independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: This proves a complete palindromic-factor spectrum only for OEIS A288462 and the corresponding exact prefix-defect threshold. It does not establish a general theorem for all Rote or morphic words. Historical-priority certainty is limited by potentially unindexed or unpublished results.
title: The complete palindromic spectrum of Kimberling's binary word
